$comment: Authored OUTSIDE Trellis and handed in complete. Copy to .trellis/product-graph.json and edit. Run `trellis ingest` — it is deliberately unforgiving, because a plausible-looking graph that plans wrong costs far more than a hard stop.

v1.definition: A single user can log a habit daily, see a streak, and keep their data across devices. Shippable and useful even if v2 is never built.

v2.definition: Shared habits with friends, a weekly digest, and an insights view that identifies which habits correlate with self-reported mood.

invariants: No personally identifying data in logs, error messages, or analytics events
Every timestamp is stored UTC and rendered in the user's zone at the edge
Any endpoint that mutates state is idempotent under retry
non_goals: Native mobile apps — web only in both versions
Real-time collaboration; the shared habits in v2 are eventually consistent

nodes.title: Core data model: users, habits, entries
acceptance: A habit belongs to exactly one user and has a stable id
An entry is unique per (habit, local calendar day)
Deleting a habit soft-deletes it and preserves its entries
nodes.notes: Uniqueness on local calendar day, not UTC day. A user in UTC+13 logging at 9pm local must not collide with the next UTC day.

nodes.title: Session-based authentication
acceptance: A valid credential pair issues a session cookie scoped to the app origin
An expired session is rejected even when the signature verifies
Logging out invalidates the session server-side, not only the cookie

nodes.title: Streak calculation
acceptance: A streak counts consecutive local calendar days with an entry
A missed day resets the streak to zero, not to one
Today counts toward the streak only once an entry exists
nodes.notes: Consumed by both the API and the digest job, so this is an interface node — write the signature during slicing, before either consumer is dispatched.

nodes.title: Log and list entries
acceptance: Logging the same habit twice in one local day is a no-op, not an error
Listing returns entries for the requesting user only
A request for another user's habit returns not-found, not forbidden

nodes.title: Today view with habit list and streaks
acceptance: Every habit shows its current streak and whether today is logged
An empty habit list shows a first-run state, not a blank page
Toggling a habit is optimistic and reconciles on failure

nodes.title: User data export
acceptance: A user can export all their habits and entries as JSON
The export contains no other user's data under any input
nodes.notes: Every dependency is already in v1, so `trellis promote` will flag this as shippable early. Deciding to move it is still a human edit to this file.

nodes.title: Habits shared between friends
acceptance: A shared habit shows both participants' streaks
Revoking a share stops updates without deleting history

nodes.title: Weekly digest email
acceptance: Each user receives at most one digest per week
A failed send retries without producing a duplicate
nodes.notes: Depends on v2 work, so it is not promotable however tempting it looks.
